title: Approval reused for different operation
description: Synthetic case: approval is bound to export report-1, not delete report-1 or export report-2.
policy_assumptions: Parent and child may request export or delete on report-1, but approval is required for the operation.
Approval cannot be reused for delete or a different target.

expected.rationale: Approval must be bound to its approved operation and relevant context.

review_notes: Review against the target system's actual policy and identity semantics.
This fixture is illustrative; it is not an implementation conformance result.
